Customer /pesanan-sukses?code=CP00000401&t=... shows hero 'PESANAN DIKIRIM — Dalam perjalanan.', order-shipment-info block with order-tracking-number 'JNE7777666' + order-tracking-link href jne.co.id target=_blank, and mobile viewport (390x844) still renders the shipment info block correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: services/shipment.py: _build validates courier+resi BEFORE calling orders_svc.transition_order — good ordering guarantees status stays 'packed' on invalid input (verified by 4 tests).
services/shipment.py._RESI regex ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{6,40}$ + spaces stripped via re.sub — matches spec (validated: 'JP 1234 5678 90' → 'JP1234567890'; 'ABC@#123$' rejected).

services/notify.py.send_shipped: idempotency key `shipped:{courier}:{tracking_number}` via _claim compare-and-set on emails_sent — re-saving same courier+resi is a no-op, changing either fires a new email. Correction detection uses `first = not any(k.startswith('shipped:') ...)` → subject/heading branches correctly.
COURIERS list uses courier `lainnya` with url=None → falls back to FALLBACK_URL 'https://cekresi.com/?noresi={resi}' with urllib.parse.quote on the resi — safe encoding.

admin_schemas.OrderStatusInput: courier/tracking_number are Optional (both applied only for shipped) — router branches to shipment_svc.ship_order which enforces presence via ShipmentError. Non-shipped transitions ignore these fields silently — acceptable.

routers/admin_orders.update_shipment: audit log uses tracking_number only (no old resi captured) — consider logging {'from': old_tn, 'to': new_tn, 'courier': courier} for better traceability if you ever need to reconstruct correction history.
